entities.name: José Pampuro
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Juan Bautista Pampuro was an Argentine politician of the Justicialist Party. He served as Defense Minister under President Kirchner and also as senator for Buenos Aires Province. From 2006 to 2011 he was the Provisional President of the Senate.
